body.content: Consider the 'Expert's Blindspot' vs 'Non-Expert's Tunnel Vision'. The expert fails when they stop seeing the data because they've already 'solved' the pattern (premature closure). The panel fails when they see the data but don't know it's relevant because it's not on the list. The 'covering principle' here might be the trade-off between 'Pattern-Based Error' and 'Rule-Based Error'.
body.why_keep_this: Explores the fundamental nature of the errors being traded off.
